LOKIFLOW

JAGANAUGHT LOQI · FALSE-EARTH ENGINE v2 · F1 TO HIDE

Every texture, mesh, environment map, biome, planet and the JaganaughtAi suit itself is generated on the GPU or from a table of numbers at load. No assets, no downloads. Terrain, deformation, cascaded shadows, the Gerstner sea, the cosmic wave field and two full procedural skeletons run per frame. Nine system worlds: open-ocean routes use the Loki cutter; ice, alpine and desert routes stay on boots or the surf board. B/V terraform, X calls the bore.
